exposure: Availability of medications and equipment at health facility
Travel time to nearest health facility
outcome: Bypassing a closer health facility for a more distant one
cohort: 1592 women in the poorest quintile of the population in Guatemala, Honduras, and Nicaragua who delivered a baby
finding: Women in the poorest quintile of Guatemala, Honduras, and Nicaragua were more likely to deliver in a health facility if they were primiparous, literate, attended antenatal care, were informed about a potential need for C-section, and had a travel time to the nearest facility of 1-2 hours compared to less than 30 minutes.
